subject: general
question:
Study the given pie charts and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9f877242b74c4ce0b539ddb44280c7447102b4e030730ce74abc22fa7ce313f.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ab5897f977c56d96def29464aa6ecec05166e901a02e99fb16391487975ed8f.png] 

What percentage of tourists went to Agra and Kashi?
solution:
**Given:**

The pie chart shows the distribution of overseas tourists across four locations:

 
• Agra = 15%
 
• Amritsar = 30%
 
• Konark = 35%
 
• Kashi = 20%

**Calculation:**

The percentage of tourists who went to Agra and Kashi:

⇒ Percentage = Agra + Kashi

⇒ Percentage = 15% + 20%

⇒ Percentage = 35%

**∴ 35% of tourists went to Agra and Kashi.**
